metadata.title: MAPP 5310.3 Rev.2 Requests for Expedited Review of New Drug Application and Biologics License Application Prior Approval Supplements Submitted for Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls Changes
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.
metadata.applicability: FDA staff procedure. Category: Regulatory Review and Scientific Policies.

candidates.statement: POLICY • In this MAPP, an expedited review means that OPQ will strive to assess and act on the PAS before the PDUFA goal date associated with that PAS. It should be noted, however, that an expedited review designation for either an NDA PAS or a BLA PAS does not change the PDUFA goal dates associated with that PAS.

candidates.statement: 1 Although OPQ also manages certain abbreviated new drug application (ANDA) supplements, these supplements should be prioritized according to MAPP 5240.3 Rev. 6 Prioritization of the Review of Original ANDAs, Amendments, and Supplements.
candidates.context: • If a public health need arises, OPQ may designate the PAS for expedited review with or without a request from an applicant. The scope of this MAPP includes both expedited review requests received internally and from an NDA or BLA applicant.

candidates.statement: • If OPQ determines that a multidisciplinary team should participate in the assessment of a PAS designated for expedited review, the OPQ Office of Program and Regulatory Operation’s Regulatory Business Project Manager (OPQ RBPM) will notify all appropriate assessment divisions and inspection divisions of the need to expedite the PAS.
candidates.context: • If OPQ grants an expedited review for a PAS, that PAS’s review completion date will depend on both the availability of OPQ’s resources and the provisions of the PAS. • OPQ will not consider a request for an expedited review that involves a facility that is subject to a recommendation of Official Action Indicated, unless an expedited review will help address a public health concern. The OPQ RBPM and appropriate OPQA supervisor, in consultation with other personnel as necessary, will determine if FDA must expedite the review to address the public health concern.

candidates.context: • If OPQ determines that a multidisciplinary team should participate in the assessment of a PAS designated for expedited review, the OPQ Office of Program and Regulatory Operation’s Regulatory Business Project Manager (OPQ RBPM) will notify all appropriate assessment divisions and inspection divisions of the need to expedite the PAS. • OPQ will consider an expedited review request for a PAS that falls into one or more of the following categories:

candidates.statement: o Drug shortages : Submissions that could help mitigate or resolve a drug shortage 2 or prevent future shortages will, as appropriate, receive an expedited review. 3 o Special review programs : Submissions that are subject to a special review program, such as the President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief, may receive expedited review.
candidates.context: • OPQ will consider an expedited review request for a PAS that falls into one or more of the following categories: 2 This includes drug products on the drug shortage list confirmed by the CDER Drug Shortages Staff. For a list of current and resolved drug shortages and discontinuations of drugs and biologics regulated by CDER, see https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/drugshortages/default.cfm .

candidates.statement: 3 As described in section 506C(g)(1) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, the FDA shall, as appropriate, prioritize and expedite the review of ANDAs and supplements for NDAs and ANDAs that could help to prevent or mitigate certain drug shortages.
candidates.context: 2 This includes drug products on the drug shortage list confirmed by the CDER Drug Shortages Staff. For a list of current and resolved drug shortages and discontinuations of drugs and biologics regulated by CDER, see https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/drugshortages/default.cfm . o Public health emergencies : Submissions that could help address a public health emergency declared by the Secretary of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, or anticipated under the same criteria, may receive expedited review.

candidates.statement: o Statutory mandates or other legal requirements : Submissions that are subject to Federal or State mandates or other legal (e.g., regulatory) actions may receive expedited review as necessary to comply with those requirements.
candidates.context: o Certain government purchasing programs : Submissions related to certain government purchasing or procurement activities, including expiration-date extensions or packaging changes usually requested by the Government-Wide Quality Assurance Program, may receive expedited review. Please note: This category also includes any legally required changes in formulation or labeling. However, PASs submitted under 21 CFR 314.70(b)(4) or 601.12(b)(4) in response to feedback from FDA about CMC changes that were not reported appropriately (e.g., certain CMC changes reported to an application as a changes being effected supplement rather than a PAS) will not be considered for expedited review.

candidates.statement:  An abrupt discontinuation of the supply of an active ingredient, the packaging material, or the product’s container closure system. If an applicant experiences one or more of these discontinuations, the PAS should document the date the applicant received notice of the discontinuation.
candidates.context: - Events that could not have been reasonably foreseen by the applicant and for which the applicant could not have planned, such as:  The relocation of a facility or a change in an existing facility because of a recent catastrophic event.

candidates.statement: • The OPQA I, II, or III supervisor (or their designee) will: o For claims related to extraordinary hardship, work with the OPQ RBPM to determine whether the PAS should be expedited.
candidates.context: o Notify the OPQ quality assessment team of the expedited review status. o For all granted expedited requests, support the expedited review of the submission.
